explanation_to_student: It looks like you made a sign error in your moment equation in Step 1. If you take the sum of moments about Node 0, the downward applied forces of 60 kN and 80 kN create clockwise moments, while the upward reaction at Node 3 creates a counter-clockwise moment. Because they cause rotation in opposite directions, they should have opposite signs in your equilibrium equation. Fixing this will give you a positive R3y of 73.33 kN, which will then correctly bring your R0y down to 66.67 kN. Recalculate your reactions with the correct signs and try Step 2 again!
